title: Rehearsal results reveal the supported document scope
method: Synthetic 100-document rehearsal with disjoint input classes. Completion requires a draft that passes defined checks and is ready for human review. The overall count is 74/100; the chart reports slice rates and does not imply customer outcomes.
alt: Rehearsal results reveal the supported document scope. Digital orders: 54/60: 90 percent with reviewable draft, Scans: 12/20: 60 percent with reviewable draft, Incomplete: 8/20: 40 percent with reviewable draft. Illustrative data.
